- Model tends to overestimate prices in early periods of the 30-day window, especially after recent spikes.
- Underestimates prices in mid-to-late periods, particularly when true values show upward momentum.
- Overreacts to short-term volatility; forecasts overshoot after sharp price increases.
- Shows persistent downward bias in later days of the forecast horizon, suggesting mean reversion is not fully captured.
- Often fails to adjust for seasonal or cyclical patterns; ignores historical mean reversion in the 30-day window.
- Tends to lag behind true price movements by 1–3 days, especially in downward trends.
- Overconfident in early forecast days; underestimates volatility in the final 5–10 days of the horizon.
